note: Rumors (M12). Each one is only shown to the cantina owner when its conditions hold in WorldState, so everything she passes on is true right now. requires: flags (all), not_flags (none), tier, standing { faction: [min, max] }, counters { name: min }, time [presets].

rumors.text: The Remnant set up a checkpoint at the front gate. They search anything bigger than a lunchbox.
The front gate gets lazy after dark. Coin helps it get lazier.
There's a Remnant patrol sitting in orbit, picking off anything that lifts without their say-so.
Somebody tore up the Remnant patrol in orbit. The gate commander is in a mood.
The Remnant are asking which ship lifted out of the pit before their patrol went quiet. They have not asked me yet.
A ship came back into the pit trailing smoke yesterday. Whoever flies it should buy a drink and count their fingers.
Someone's been letting off a blaster in the street. The Remnant noticed, and they're counting.
The practice range down in the pit has a standing bet: knock all five targets flat in under twenty seconds.
Somebody finally cleared the practice range under twenty. The losers are still paying.
There's a sparring drone in the pit that spits stun bolts at anyone with a blade out. Good practice, if you like being stung.
People say you've got quick hands with that blade. Sending bolts back where they came from is how legends start, and how short lives end.
Water's up again. The Remnant took the old well and the haulers are watering the water.
The Remnant have your description. Not a good one.
The locals have started saying your name without spitting first. That's practically a parade.
The fixer by the tables has a crate job out at the old outpost. Pays well. Pays well because people don't come back.
There was shooting at the front gate. The Remnant are walking around like someone stepped on their boots.
Two gate guards came back from their shift on stretchers. Somebody's going to get blamed, and it's not going to be the stretchers.
Word is the gate took someone's coin last night and forgot their face. Happens more than they admit.
Somebody left a drop out past the front gate. Unmarked cells. The fence in the market would pay, if you could get them past the gate.
The gate took a case of cells off somebody today. The fence is in mourning.
The klaxon went off at the barracks today. Half the garrison ran to the front gate with their boots untied.
Nobody sane walks the market at noon. The sun out there has a grudge.
